mnemolith.configuration.title: Mnemolith
mnemolith.configuration.recollectionStor: Multiplier applied to memory-pressure thresholds before a recollection storm can start.
Soft cap for memory pressure accumulated from imprints in loaded chunks.
mnemolith.configuration.imprintNodeWeigh: Relative weight of imprint-bearing nodes when structures are placed.
mnemolith.configuration.stormAttemptChan: Chance, from 0.0 to 1.0, that a pressure check attempts a recollection storm.
mnemolith.configuration.structuresEnable: Whether the chronicle observatory may generate. Applies the next time a world loads.
mnemolith.configuration.structureSpacing: Documented observatory spacing in chunks. The structure set uses 32, with 12 chunks of separation.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinsEna: Whether archival veins generate in the overworld.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinChan: Chance, out of 100, that a chunk attempts an archival vein.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinMinY: Lowest Y of an archival vein.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinMaxY: Highest Y of an archival vein.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinSize: Length, in blocks, of one archival vein.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalBleed.to: Pressure added per archival stratum block.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalBleedCap: Most stratum blocks that add pressure in one chunk.
mnemolith.configuration.mutePocketsEnabl: Whether mute pockets generate. Their mute stone blocks writes.
mnemolith.configuration.mutePocketChance: Chance, out of 100, that a chunk attempts a mute pocket.
mnemolith.configuration.mutePocketMinY.t: Lowest Y of a mute pocket.
mnemolith.configuration.mutePocketMaxY.t: Highest Y of a mute pocket.
mnemolith.configuration.observatoryEnabl: Whether chronicle observatories generate. Also requires structures enabled.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistObserva: Lowers an archivist's pressure gate near an observatory.
Lowers an echo strider's pressure gate in a chunk that holds a path imprint.
mnemolith.configuration.compositionEnabl: Whether players may compose extracted imprints.
mnemolith.configuration.maxImprintsPerCh: Maximum imprints stored on a single chunk.
mnemolith.configuration.allowRecollectio: Whether recollection storms are allowed to start.
mnemolith.configuration.maxStormsPerDime: Maximum recollection storms active in one dimension at once.
mnemolith.configuration.logPressureChang: Whether pressure changes are written to the server log.
mnemolith.configuration.imprintParticles: Whether custom memory particles are shown.
mnemolith.configuration.pressureVignette: Whether rising memory pressure darkens the screen edge.
mnemolith.configuration.stormScreenShake: Whether a recollection storm shakes the camera.
mnemolith.configuration.memoryAudioVolum: Volume scale, from 0.0 to 1.0, for the local chronicle lens chime.
Scale, from 0.0 to 1.0, for every custom memory particle. 0 disables them.
mnemolith.configuration.maxParticlesPerT: Hard cap on custom memory particles spawned in one client tick. Density still scales the budget, and 0 density disables them.
mnemolith.configuration.ambientWithoutLe: Whether saturated chunks shimmer when the chronicle lens is not held. Vein marks stay lens-only.
mnemolith.configuration.lensPollInterval: Ticks between chronicle lens pressure requests.
mnemolith.configuration.writeDebounceTic: Ticks that must pass before another build or redstone imprint can be written in the same chunk.
mnemolith.configuration.writeDeath.toolt: Whether a death writes a death imprint.
mnemolith.configuration.writeExplosion.t: Whether an explosion writes an explosion imprint.
mnemolith.configuration.writeFall.toolti: Whether a significant fall writes a fall imprint.
mnemolith.configuration.writeBuild.toolt: Whether placing or breaking a block writes a build or redstone imprint.
Minimum fall distance, in blocks, before a fall imprint is written.
mnemolith.configuration.extractionDurabi: Durability the extraction needle loses on a successful extract.
mnemolith.configuration.extractionCooldo: Ticks before the extraction needle can extract again. 0 disables the cooldown.
mnemolith.configuration.failurePressureS: Instability added to the composition reel's chunk when a formula fails. A replicant is asked only if that chunk is then overloaded or fractured.
mnemolith.configuration.instabilityDecay: Instability removed from a player's chunk on each decay pulse. 0 disables cooling.
Ticks between instability and quiet-imprint pulses while a player is in the chunk. 0 disables the pulse.
mnemolith.configuration.veinShimmerTicks: Ticks between vein particle repeats while a held lens snapshot has not changed. 0 repeats only when the snapshot is new. A changed chunk still shimmers immediately.
mnemolith.configuration.quietFadeTicks.t: Ticks before the oldest build, redstone, or path imprint can fade. Loud imprints stay until extracted. 0 disables the fade.
mnemolith.configuration.saturatedThresho: Pressure at which a chunk becomes saturated.
mnemolith.configuration.overloadedThresh: Pressure at which a chunk becomes overloaded.
mnemolith.configuration.fractureThreshol: Pressure at which a chunk fractures. Fracture is logged and can spawn a moment replicant.
mnemolith.configuration.muteRadiusChunks: Chebyshev radius, in chunks, where a mute stone blocks imprint writes. 0 is the stone's own chunk.
mnemolith.configuration.echoStriderEnabl: Whether echo striders may spawn from pressure and whether their AI runs.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistEnabled: Whether archivists may spawn from pressure and whether they steal slips.
mnemolith.configuration.momentReplicantE: Whether moment replicants may spawn from fracture, an overloaded composition failure, or natural pressure.
mnemolith.configuration.echoStriderDamag: Attack damage of an echo strider charge.
Attack damage when a moment replicant copies a melee hit.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistStealCo: Ticks an archivist waits after a theft before it can steal again.
mnemolith.configuration.echoStriderSpawn: Chance, out of 100, that a natural echo strider spawn attempt is kept.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistSpawnWe: Chance, out of 100, that a natural archivist spawn attempt is kept.
mnemolith.configuration.replicantSpawnWe: Chance, out of 100, that a natural moment replicant spawn attempt is kept.
mnemolith.configuration.echoStriderMinPr: Minimum cached pressure before an echo strider can spawn naturally.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistMinPres: Minimum cached pressure before an archivist can spawn naturally. The default sits on the overloaded band.
mnemolith.configuration.replicantMinPres: Minimum cached pressure before a moment replicant can spawn naturally.
mnemolith.configuration.sensorInterval.t: Ticks between archivist resonator scans, flee pressure scans, and idle strider repaths. A charge still aims every tick. 1 checks every tick.
item.mnemolith.chronicle_lens.hint: Hold to read memory pressure as a pill above the hotbar. Sneak for the chunk state. Near archival strata the read reaches one chunk farther, and the stone glows. Sneak and use to blind moment replicants.
item.mnemolith.extraction_needle.hint: Use on a block to pull the strongest imprint into a slip. It rests for a moment between pulls. In a stratum chunk, an empty read also checks the neighbor chunks.
mnemolith.message.extract_empty: This chunk has no imprint to extract.
mnemolith.message.compose_fail: The slips refuse to hold together.
mnemolith.command.perf: Perf pathNs %s buildNs %s scoreNs %s syncNs %s skipped %s sensorNs %s
mnemolith.command.mpsmoke: MP smoke sameBand %s discovery %s steal %s reel %s mute %s replicants %s guarded %s
item.mnemolith.archivist_bait.hint: Drop it. An archivist will take the bait and freeze. Compose silence and player slips to make one.
item.mnemolith.archival_tablet.hint: Silence and a player, composed, become bait. A vein of this stone bleeds a little pressure and lets the lens read farther.
mnemolith.configuration.catalogEnabled.t: Whether a catalog fragment opens the discovery catalog.
mnemolith.configuration.discoveryHints.t: Whether the catalog and reel may show how many stable patterns are still unread. Unread patterns stay hidden.
mnemolith.configuration.lensOverlay.tool: Whether the chronicle lens draws the pressure pill above the hotbar.
mnemolith.configuration.overlayOpacity.t: Opacity, from 0.2 to 1.0, of the lens pressure pill. The band name stays readable.
mnemolith.configuration.showNumericPress: Whether the lens pill includes the numeric pressure beside the band name.
mnemolith.gui.catalog_empty: Extract an imprint. The catalog keeps only what you have learned.
mnemolith.gui.compose_fail: The slips refuse to hold together.
mnemolith.message.mute_first: Mute stone. This chunk will not take new imprints.
mnemolith.message.observatory_first: Chronicle observatory. The reel here still answers to the same formulas.

mnemolith.guide.loop.title: The memory loop
mnemolith.guide.loop.body: The world writes imprints into a chunk. Pressure there climbs from calm through saturated and overloaded to fracture. The needle lifts the strongest imprint into a slip and records that tag for you. Two slips on a reel become a formula or a failure. The catalog fragment shows only what you already learned.
mnemolith.guide.sources.title: Where imprints come from
mnemolith.guide.sources.body: Walking writes a path about every 12 blocks. Placing or breaking blocks writes build, and redstone writes redstone, with a pause between those writes. Death and explosions are loud. A long fall writes fall. A mute stone first writes silence. An unwitnessed death can add silence too. A nearby player can add the player tag.
mnemolith.guide.bands.title: Pressure bands
mnemolith.guide.bands.body: Defaults: calm below 20, saturated from 20, overloaded from 50, fracture from 80, soft cap 100. Fracture is logged and asks for one moment replicant. It does not start a storm. Failed-compose instability cools while you stand in the chunk. Old path, build, and redstone fade. Loud imprints stay until you extract them.
mnemolith.guide.mute.title: Mute stone
mnemolith.guide.mute.body: Craft an ink sac, an amethyst shard, and cobblestone in a column. Placing the stone writes silence, then blocks new imprints in its chunk and a configured radius of loaded chunks. An echo strider retreats there and does not spawn naturally. Breaking the stone lifts the mute.
mnemolith.guide.crafts.title: Tools and crafts
mnemolith.guide.crafts.body: Lens: amethyst, glass pane, copper. Held, it shows the pressure pill; sneak adds the chunk state. Sneak and use it to blind nearby replicants. Needle: amethyst, iron, stick, used on a block, costing 2 durability with a one-second rest. Reel: copper, paper, crafting table. Catalog: paper, amethyst, ink sac. This book: a book over an amethyst shard. Resonator: redstone, copper, cobblestone. It stuns an archivist within 4 blocks.
mnemolith.guide.formulas.title: Formulas
mnemolith.guide.formulas.body: Death and silence is Unrecorded for 15 seconds: mobs drop you as a target. Fire and build is a fire trail for 12 seconds, with fire resistance, a small speed bonus, and melting snow underfoot. Fall and player lasts 20 seconds and softens the next hard landing once. Silence and player gives archivist bait. Drop that bait on the ground.
mnemolith.guide.fails.title: A failed compose
mnemolith.guide.fails.body: A wrong pair destroys one slip and adds instability, 18 by default. On a calm chunk the band stays calm and no replicant is asked. If the spike leaves the chunk overloaded or fractured, the server asks for one moment replicant. A second one is not asked while one is already in that chunk's column.
mnemolith.guide.strider.title: Echo strider
mnemolith.guide.strider.body: It walks your recent path. It charges when the chunk is overloaded or fractured, or when you hit it, after a short telegraph. A mute stone makes it retreat. Sneaking with the lens in hand, within 8 blocks, does the same. It spawns only in a loud enough chunk, and not in a muted one.
mnemolith.guide.archivist.title: Archivist
mnemolith.guide.archivist.body: It takes one slip from an open container, your hand, or the ground, preferring the heavier tag, then runs. Dropped bait within 10 blocks draws it in; it eats one and freezes for 5 seconds. A resonator within 4 blocks stuns it for 4 seconds. It spawns in a loud chunk, and the pressure gate is lower near an observatory.
mnemolith.guide.replicant.title: Moment replicant
mnemolith.guide.replicant.body: It appears when a chunk first fractures and when a loud compose fails. It copies your last hit, jump, placed block, or item use. It telegraphs for about 3 seconds, then replays. Sneak and use the lens: replicants within 12 blocks are blinded for 4 seconds. Stay out of overloaded chunks when you are not ready for one.
mnemolith.guide.world.title: Places in the world
mnemolith.guide.world.body: An archival vein is underground stone, about 8% of chunks, from Y -48 to 32. Stratum adds a little pressure, and the lens reads one chunk farther while you hold it. A mute pocket, about 4% of chunks, is lined with mute stone so writes stop; some have a chest. An observatory is about one every 32 chunks. Its chest always has a lens or a needle, plus a tablet, mute stone, teaching slips, and rarely a catalog or this book.
mnemolith.guide.players.title: Several players
mnemolith.guide.players.body: The server decides writes, pressure, extracts, and composes. Discovery is per player: your catalog does not show someone else's tags. An archivist takes one slip from a shared open container, so every viewer loses that same slip. The lens band matches the server. This book only explains the rules. It does not change the chunk.
